title: Streaming schema compatibility and rollback test harness
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a deterministic test harness that validates streaming JSON-mode outputs across model variants, ensures constrained-decoding compatibility with tool/function-calling payloads, and exercises schema rollback scenarios. The harness must simulate realistic network chunking, streaming partial tokens (including mid-object cuts), KV cache replay, and SDK clients that expect either full JSON objects or NDJSON lines. The goal is to catch regressions where streaming+tools produce unparsable partial output or incompatible shape changes during rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay 10K synthetic streaming sessions with configurable chunk size distributions
Decoder resume test: when a stream is cut mid-object, constrained decoder resumes and produces a parseable object in >99.5% of runs
Tool-calling compatibility: function call payloads emitted during streaming are captured and match the schema exactly for 3 supported SDK versions
Rollback scenarios: when a new schema is rolled out and then reverted, harness detects schema drift and produces a regression alert with example failing streams
CI gating: harness runs in nightly CI with pass/fail thresholds and stores failing traces in a central S3 bucket for debugging
technical_notes: Simulate network: randomize chunk sizes using a Weibull distribution to mimic real-world TCP segmentation and browser streaming
Streaming decoder: exercise both strict and tolerant constrained decoders; tolerant mode emits recovery candidates and strict mode must return deterministic failure paths
Tool calling interplay: validate that tool payloads are emitted as separate well-formed JSON objects or as part of the main object depending on model config; add tests for both patterns
KV cache replay: include tests that rehydrate KV cache mid-stream to ensure decoder behavior is unchanged after cache warmup/rewind
Compatibility layer: include an adapter that converts partial streamed arrays into complete objects for legacy SDKs and verify parity against native streaming clients
Observability: record parse_error_rate, avg_recovery_latency_ms, failed_stream_sample_id in test metrics for each run
test_plan: Create fixture corpus from recent production traces (anonymized) and hand-crafted edge cases: nested arrays, trailing commas, truncated unicode sequences
Implement chunker library that emits configurable chunk boundaries and payload noise (e.g., stray newlines) and integrate into harness
Run baseline across 3 model variants (quantized v1, fp16 v2, rollout-experiment) and capture differences in parseability
Add SDK matrix: run against JS SDK v0.9 (legacy full-JSON), JS SDK v1.2 (stream-aware), Python SDK v1.0; assert compatibility with adapter
Introduce rollout+rollback simulation: toggle schema version header mid-run and ensure harness flags cross-version incompatibilities
Add CI job: nightly-inference-schema-harness that uploads results and opens an issue template when thresholds are exceeded
